_provenance: (V26.17 era), cross-checked against ddragon 16.17.1, the meraki champion
snapshot (14.24 baseline) and Riot's own 16.17 game files
base, ratio, cooldown and duration below agrees across all four. Wiki
patch numbering V26.xx maps to ddragon 16.xx.
Recent history: V25.23 base HP 600 (was 607) and armor 24 (was 27);
V26.17 Crimson Pact bug fix (rune AP now converts). No other Summoner's
Rift change to the kit in the V26 cycle. Riot's own recommended skill
order (game files): Q > E > W, R when available.
Modeling notes the sources do not settle: the Crimson Rush surge is
taken to open when Q comes off cooldown after the 2nd cast (the only
reading that fits a 4.6s cooldown); Riftmaker's Void Infusion is taken
to count the pact's bonus health (see resolve_stats).
Base stats are NOT duplicated here — the stat layer reads them from
data/builds/champions/<patch>/vladimir/. This file is only what no
structured source has: the kit's damage logic and its channel rules.
name: Vladimir

attack.note: windup = attackCastTime 0.3 / attackTotalTime 1.52 (meraki); autos are filler between casts, no resets in the kit

crimsonPact.note: the health it grants never feeds its own AP conversion; the AP it grants is multiplied by Rabadon's like any other AP

crimsonRush.note: each cast banks a point over its cooldown; at 2 the surge opens for 2.5s and the next Transfusion deals 85% more (148-296 +111% AP). Cast on cooldown, every third Q is the empowered one

W.name: Sanguine Pool

damage.note: totals over the pool; ticks at 0/0.5/1.0/1.5s

W.note: untargetable for 2s: no attacks and no casts, except releasing a Tides of Blood that was already charging

E.name: Tides of Blood

damage.note: grows linearly over the first second of the charge, then holds; maxHpRatio is Vladimir's OWN max health

E.note: no attacks while charging; Q or R would end the charge (auto-release), so the sim holds them until the release; W is allowed

R.name: Hemoplague
R.note: infected targets take 10% more damage from all sources (true damage excepted) for 4s, including the burst that ends it
